verdict.rationale: Drata's public APIv2 documents a Custom Connections resource with create, update and delete endpoints, plus Create Custom Monitoring Test, Evidence Library create/update, and an experimental (🧪) endpoint to push devices into a custom connection. Together these let developers integrate on-premise or uncovered systems. However, the evidence is mostly endpoint titles: there is no explicit endpoint or guide for pushing test results or pass/fail outcomes, and device push is experimental, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: a documented endpoint for submitting monitoring test results from custom systems, in-depth custom-integration guides beyond endpoint names, a non-experimental push for custom-connection data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build private/custom integrations against a documented API to push evidence and test results from systems the catalog doesn't cover

citations.quote: Build deep integrations with any system. Connect on-premise tools and custom workflows to automate evidence collection.
Create Custom Connection ... Update Custom Connection ... Delete Custom Connection
List Monitoring Tests ... Create Custom Monitoring Test ... Get Monitoring Test ... Update Monitoring Test
Create Evidence Library Item ... Update Evidence Library Item ... Delete Evidence Library Item ... Get Evidence Library Version
Create or update Device for Custom Connection 🧪 ... List Apps for Device
